subject: Implementation sprint: streaming & function-calling enablement
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Arjun Patel <arjun@meditech.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 May 2028 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Implementation sprint: streaming & function-calling enablement

Hi Arjun —

Thanks again for the kickoff yesterday. I’m putting the initial implementation sprint plan together so our teams can align on scope, owners, and a tight first-delivery milestone (staging demo with streaming and function/tool calling enabled). Attached is a lightweight checklist we typically use for the first two-week sprint.

Can you confirm:
- Primary technical contact for JSON schema ownership (api/contract owner)
- Preferred window for our first concrete walkthrough (30–45 min) next week
- Any hard constraints around PII, retention, or network egress we should flag now

Proposed quick agenda for the walkthrough:
1) Staging environment and access matrix
2) Streaming integration (prefix caching, low-latency expectations)
3) Function/tool calling patterns and API contract
4) JSON schema expectations, validation, and error handling
5) Action items & success criteria for the sprint demo

Attachment: [MediTech-Implementation-Checklist.xlsx (Spreadsheet, 48KB)]

Thanks — I’ll block a few slots and will pivot based on your availability.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0183

From: Arjun Patel <arjun@meditech.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Leila Gomez <leila@meditech.ai>, devops@meditech.ai, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 May 2028 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Implementation sprint: streaming & function-calling enablement

On Tue, May 20, 2028 at 9:22 AM Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Arjun —
> 
> Thanks again for the kickoff yesterday...

Thanks Soojin — this looks good.

Quick answers:
- JSON/schema owner: Leila (cc’d) will own schema validation and sign-off.
- Walkthrough: We can do Thursday 2028-05-23 at 10:00 PT or Friday 2028-05-24 at 14:00 PT.
- Constraints: We need the streaming path to avoid persisting any PHI to Redwood logs; we’ll use tokenized user ids and keep full records in our internal audit logs only. We’ll share the retention policy doc ahead of the call.

Two technical clarifications before the walkthrough:
1) For function/tool calling, do you support async tool responses (webhook callback) or only synchronous invocation?
2) For structured outputs, do you recommend we send a draft schema first or should we mirror Redwood’s sample schema?

Thanks — Arjun
Head of Product Engineering
MediTech Health
arjun@meditech.ai

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Arjun Patel <arjun@meditech.ai>
Cc: Leila Gomez <leila@meditech.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 May 2028 14:36:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Implementation sprint: streaming & function-calling enablement

On Wed, May 21, 2028 at 11:08 AM Arjun Patel <arjun@meditech.ai> wrote:
> Thanks Soojin — this looks good.
> 
> Quick answers:...

Great — thanks for the quick turnaround. Thursday 2028-05-23 10:00 PT works for us; I’ll send a calendar invite with the Zoom link.

To answer the two technical clarifications:
1) Function/tool calling: Redwood supports both synchronous and asynchronous tool patterns. For async callbacks we use a secure webhook with HMAC verification; we’ll include the reference spec in the shared folder.
2) Structured outputs: please send your draft schema first. We’ll validate against Redwood’s schema rules and provide example transformer snippets (we’ll attach an initial sample schema to this thread).

I’ve sketched initial action items below (owners in parentheses):
- Share draft JSON schema (Leila) — due: Tue 2028-05-28
- Provide staging environment access & IP allowlist (MediTech DevOps) — due: Thu 2028-05-24
- DocuSign SOW sent for signature (Marissa) — due: Fri 2028-05-26
- Pre-demo test vectors (MediTech) — due: Mon 2028-05-29

Attachment: [streaming-schema-v1.json (JSON, 12KB)]
Shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB3-Implementation-MT2389
Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/91234567890?pwd=onboard

We’ll cover the webhook HMAC and expected event types in the walkthrough. If there’s anything else you want on the agenda, drop it here and I’ll add.

Best,
Soojin
